"Let me read the current files I'll be modifying, plus confirm the sprite's symbol IDs.Let me verify the sprite contains the icon IDs I'll reference (blog-icon especially).All icon IDs exist including `blog-icon`. Since I'll switch to `next/image` loading remote `image.maudau.com.ua` URLs, I need to configure `next.config.mjs`. Let me check it.All icon IDs are confirmed, and `images.unoptimized: true` means `next/image` will pass remote URLs through without needing `remotePatterns`. Now I'll build the optimizations. First, the isolated client price module with a fixed-size skeleton to prevent CLS.Now rewrite the product card as a client component with `next/image`, the outbound tracking hook, and the price module:Now the hero with `next/image`, `priority`, and `sizes="100vw"`:Now the category section — apply `@container` and container-query grid classes:Now the comprehensive trust footer with all three columns, brand row, and legal bottom row:Now let me verify everything compiles and renders, and measure Web Vitals (the request targets sub-2.5s LCP / zero CLS).All 15 cards render, the three footer columns are present, and the `aria-live` price region exists. Let me capture screenshots and check the container-query grid plus CLS.The optimization pass is complete and verified in the browser. Summary of changes:

- **Images → `next/image`**: the hero now uses `<Image fill priority={true} sizes="100vw" />`, and every product image uses `<Image fill loading="lazy" sizes="(max-width: 768px) 50vw, (max-width: 1024px) 33vw, 25vw" />` with `alt` mirroring each product title.
- **CLS-safe dynamic pricing**: extracted a `'use client'` `ProductPrice` module with a `useEffect` 1000ms latency simulation that renders a fixed-height (`h-7`) grey shimmer skeleton inside an `aria-live="polite"` region, so the price swap reserves its space and shifts nothing.
- **Tailwind 4 container queries**: each category grid is wrapped in `@container` with `grid grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2 @lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6` (verified resolving to 3 columns).
- **Outbound telemetry**: a `handleOutboundClick(productId, targetUrl)` hook pushes to `dataLayer` on card click, and all outbound product/footer links now carry `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
- **Trust footer**: rebuilt as a dark `<footer>` (`bg-[var(--color-maudau-dark)] text-white py-12 px-6 mt-16`) with the brand logo row, a Допомога link grid (including the `#blog-icon` sprite), a Служба підтримки column with `tel:`/`mailto:` endpoints, accessible social badges, and the legal bottom row.

One note: `/sun.webp` still returns 404 (the asset isn't in the project), so the hero graphic renders empty — drop `sun.webp` into `public/` and it will display via the optimized priority `Image`."

"Let me read my current files to refine them precisely.Let me read the remaining components and the sprite to confirm icon IDs.Let me confirm the sprite's symbol IDs, especially for the cashback icon.Now I'll apply the refinements. Starting with the design tokens in `globals.css`.Now the hero with the split Z-pattern, emerald CTA, and image in the right column.Now the product card with the clickable-card pattern, pricing styles, badge logic, and non-interactive "Купити".Now update the category grid to the exact 3-column responsive logic.Now add focus rings to the header nav links and target button.Now the footer — switch to a dark context so the logo uses `--color-secondary-95`, and fix text contrast.Let me verify the refined page in the browser.The hero, pricing (red), and footer (dark) all look correct. But the logo and "Всі акції" link still render green — let me check whether the purple token actually resolved, and the `sun.webp` is missing (showing alt text).The file is correct — the browser is serving stale CSS. Let me hard reload and re-check.Still stale. Let me search for competing definitions of `--primary-500`.Two real issues: `/sun.webp` returns 404, and the compiled CSS is stale. Let me restart the dev server to force a clean Tailwind recompile.While it restarts, I'll fix the missing hero image. Since `/sun.webp` isn't in the project, I'll point to a descriptive placeholder so the hero isn't broken.The dev server isn't running. Let me start it fresh.The token now resolves correctly — logo is `rgb(55, 31, 94)` (#371f5e purple). It was just a stale Turbopack cache. Let me capture final screenshots.The refined Maudau picnic landing page is complete and verified in the browser. All requested specs are in place:

- **Brand tokens** added to `globals.css` (`--color-maudau-blue` #0052f6, `--color-maudau-red` #dc2626, emerald #047857 / hover #064e3b, dark #0f172a, gray #f8fafc, `--color-primary-500` #371f5e, `--color-secondary-95` #a4ffb8). A stale Turbopack cache was masking the change, so I restarted the dev server to confirm the purple logo now resolves to `rgb(55, 31, 94)`.
- **Hero**: split Z-pattern with the `<h1>` "Відпочинок на природі без зайвих турбот", the pitch copy, and an emerald CTA (`bg-[var(--color-maudau-emerald)] hover:bg-[var(--color-maudau-emerald-hover)]`) on the left, image column on the right.
- **Product cards**: struck-through `text-slate-400` full price, extra-bold `text-[var(--color-maudau-red)]` sale price, blue "Новинка" badge on the Скаут set, the `#national-cashback-icon` sprite badge on Сацебелі, a stretched `<a>` (`after:absolute after:inset-0 after:z-10`) inside a `relative` `<article>`, a non-interactive `<div>` "Купити" affordance, and the blue focus ring.
- **Grid** uses `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 w-full`; header/nav/card links all carry the `focus-visible` ring; the footer is now a dark context with the logo in `--color-secondary-95`.

Note: `/sun.webp` returned 404 since the asset isn't in the project, so the hero image currently points to a placeholder — drop your `sun.webp` into `public/` (and revert the `src` to `/sun.webp`) and it will display."

"I have everything I need. Let me copy the sprite into `public/` and build the page.Now let me set up the brand colors and fonts. I'll add maudau brand tokens to globals.css.Now let me update the layout with proper metadata and the html background.Now the catalog data file:Now the components. Starting with the header:Now the product card and category section:Now the footer and the JSON-LD schema component:Now the main page that assembles everything:Let me verify the page renders correctly in the browser.The landing page renders cleanly and matches all the spec requirements. The semantic structure is in place: a sticky `<header>` with the SVG-sprite logo, a `<nav aria-label=\"Категорії товарів\">` with anchor jump-links, five `<section>` blocks each with a matching `id` and `<h2>`, product `<article>` wrappers carrying `data-testid=\"productItem\"`, and a combined `WebPage` + `ItemList` JSON-LD script — all inside a single `<main>`.\n\nI built it mobile-first with a green Maudau brand palette (themed via design tokens in `globals.css`), discount/custom badges, struck-through full prices, and a footer using the sprite's social and payment icons. The hero references `/sun.webp` as a decorative overlay; add that image to `public/` and it will appear behind the banner. Functional commerce elements (cart, search, ratings, reviews, bonuses, favorites) were intentionally excluded per the brief."
